decisions.name: Village Team Victory

known: After death-chain, evaluate simultaneously; counted pending revival matters; independent contender prevents population-based endgame
options: Village wins when all current wolves and independent contenders are eliminated; define winning membership incl dead separately
Require a living/countable village member and a distinct membership rule when all village members are dead; specify simultaneous personal wins
previousUnresolvedAlternatives.discriminator: Deck 8,9: #9 hangs #8. Another case: all village players dead, all wolves and independent contenders die in same chain. Pending revival and team-transition cases also distinguish membership.
previousUnresolvedAlternatives.recommendation: Adopt explicit Village predicate with at least one countable current village member, no remaining wolves and no independent contender, separately confirm dead village membership and simultaneous personal winners. Not official until approved.

decisions.name: Hunter Pin Expiration

known: May mark every night; marked player dies when Hunter actually killed/hanged unless valid defense. Source does not specify skip-next-night expiry.
options: Mark lasts until the next night begins; skipped next-night choice leaves no active mark
Last mark persists until replaced or target eliminated
previousUnresolvedAlternatives.discriminator: Mark A night 1, skip night 2, Hunter dies night 2 or day 2; options disagree whether A dies.
previousUnresolvedAlternatives.recommendation: Current round-only validity with explicit expiry at next-night start is a candidate, but owner must settle expiry. Existing stale mark test preserved; engine fails closed when it matters.
